review.approval_scope_excerpt: Applying these two notes and their lexical metadata to the existing draft, preserving its Hebrew, marker-free English and recorded history. This is not approval of earliest-wording priority, a fresh transcription, the entire verse's translation, full-schema compliance, public deployment or publication. No blinded comparison is claimed.
assessment: Notea correctly separates received Hebrew from a Greek first-person form and explicitly prevents wholly supplied Qumran clauses from settling the suffix.

The dossier preserves Swete's addition-only apparatus unit separately from later complete-form reports. The8Hev wording remains a scholarly report, not verified preservation or independent direct Hebrew.
Faithfulness is reasonable in the waiting/steadfastness versus arrogance context. Noteb preserves faith/trust without falsely treating them as different consonantal texts.
The brief faith-and-works caution prevents the gloss from being presented as resolving later theology; it adds no doctrinal conclusion.
review.strongest_counterarguments: Greek μου could reflect genuinely different Hebrew באמונתי, and faithfulness can underemphasize trust. Neither is resolved by the supplied Hebrew clauses or pesher interpretation.
